title: CITY TOUR CUSCO
description: Explore the imperial city of Cusco and discover its rich history blending Incan culture with Spanish colonial heritage. A perfect tour for your first day of acclimatization.
shortItinerary: Morning: Plaza de Armas, Cathedral, Qoricancha
Afternoon: Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara, Tambomachay

itinerary.title: Full City Tour
itinerary.description: We start at the Plaza de Armas, visit the Cathedral and the Qoricancha temple. In the afternoon we ascend to the ruins of Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara, and Tambomachay.

recommendations: Bring a rain jacket in case of rain
